```python
def distinct_subsequences(s):
    MOD = 10**9 + 7
    n = len(s)
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    dp[0] = 1
    last_occurrence = {}
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        dp[i] = (2 * dp[i - 1]) % MOD
        if s[i - 1] in last_occurrence:
            dp[i] = (dp[i] - dp[last_occurrence[s[i - 1]] - 1] + MOD) % MOD
        last_occurrence[s[i - 1]] = i
    return dp[n]
```
